learning_objective: 🎯 Let us discover why our school is like a wonderful second home where we learn, play, and grow together!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: School is a magical place where we do not just read books, but we also make lifelong friends, sing songs, play sports, and learn how to be kind humans!
Whether we are doing a science project or playing a game on the field, working together makes us stronger. When we help each other, everyone wins!
Our school is our second home. We must keep our classrooms, playgrounds, and toilets clean by always throwing wrappers in the dustbin and respecting school property.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Say Thank You!
fun_activity.instructions: Make a beautiful colorful card using your crayons and give it to the school guard, cleaner, or bus driver to thank them for keeping you safe and happy!

quick_recap: ⭐ School is a special community where we learn new things, share ideas, and make great friends.
⭐ Teamwork and helping our classmates makes learning much more fun and exciting.
⭐ It is everyone's duty to keep the school clean, neat, and beautiful.
